captions.detailed: This is a clamp-mount task lamp constructed with a matte black and metallic silver finish. It features a heavy-duty C-clamp base with a threaded screw mechanism for desk mounting, leading up to a revolute shoulder joint. A single arm assembly, supported by dual parallel tension springs, extends to a pivoting cylindrical lamp shade housing a small bulb.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a clamp-mount task lamp. The assembly must include a C-clamp base with a threaded tightening screw, a single-segment arm supported by dual tension springs attached via a revolute shoulder joint, and a pivoting cylindrical lamp shade at the end of the arm.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining three main parts: a base, an arm, and a head. The base uses a C-shaped Box primitive with a thin Cylinder representing the clamping screw. The arm is constructed using a central cylindrical rod alongside helix-like spring sweeps or repeating ring structures for the tension springs. The head is made of a hollowed cylindrical shade containing a small bulb sphere. These parts are then connected using revolute joints with specified rotation axes and limits.
